name: spring-scale-in
title: Spring Scale In
description: Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a spring settling into place.
useWhen: The scene calls for energy and bounce: product launches, celebration moments, fun CTAs.
You want each word to snap into place with a soft overshoot.
avoidWhen: The brand is serious or premium: use scale-down-fade or soft-blur-in.
The text is long and many bouncing words would be noisy: use staggered-fade-up.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Words that pop in one after another.

variables.label: Stagger
variables.description: Frames between each word popping in (30 fps).

variables.label: Scale from
variables.description: Scale each word starts at before it springs to 1.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
